title: Eliminate masked proof debt surfaced by 9efd9c39 code review
description:
## Context

Code review on 9efd9c39 (`run_id e58a259e`, 2026-05-15) surfaced three concrete proof-debt items that the passing `lake-build` gate does not catch. The reviewer issued PASS on 9efd9c39 because the items are pre-existing and out of that issue's stated scope, but flagged them as load-bearing for any future claim that QuadraticExt / CubicExt are formally verified.

**Scope amendment 2026-05-15 (user-approved):** Problem 1 originally listed only the 3 `@[progress]`-tagged sorrys in `ExtProgress.lean` because those were the reviewer's headline finding. The new strict-build wrapper introduced for Problem 2 catches every hand-written `Proofs/` sorry, and the criterion ("`lake build` exits 0 ... do not include any in the hand-written `Proofs/` files") implies the gate must pass — therefore all 11 hand-written `Proofs/` sorrys are in scope, not just 3. The 8 additional sites in `Progress.lean` and `MontgomeryRoundtrip.lean` are the same shape of masked debt (declared theorems whose proof terms are `sorry`).

## Problems

### Problem 1 — eleven `sorry`-backed lemmas in hand-written `Proofs/` mask correctness

Full inventory at HEAD (post-9efd9c39):

| File | Line | Theorem | `@[progress]`? | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------------|-------|
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/ExtProgress.lean` | `:105` | `qinv_closure_progress` | no  | required by `qinv_progress` |
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/ExtProgress.lean` | `:115` | `qinv_progress`         | yes | downstream: `QuadraticExtField.lean:86` (`inv_correct`) |
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/ExtProgress.lean` | `:219` | `cinv_progress`         | yes | downstream: `CubicExtField.lean:95` (`inv_correct`) |
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/Progress.lean` | `:379` | `mul_progress`          | (verify when starting) | Fp Montgomery multiplication |
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/Progress.lean` | `:408` | `fp_new_progress`       | (verify) | `Fp.new` |
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/Progress.lean` | `:412` | `fp_value_progress`     | (verify) | `Fp.value` |
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/Progress.lean` | `:530` | `inv_progress`          | (verify) | base-field Fp inversion |
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/MontgomeryRoundtrip.lean` | `:591` | (verify when starting) | (verify) | Montgomery roundtrip site 1 |
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/MontgomeryRoundtrip.lean` | `:637` | (verify) | (verify) | Montgomery roundtrip site 2 |
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/MontgomeryRoundtrip.lean` | `:644` | (verify) | (verify) | Montgomery roundtrip site 3 |
| `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/MontgomeryRoundtrip.lean` | `:1345` | (verify) | (verify) | Montgomery roundtrip site 4 |

Because several of these theorems carry `@[progress]`, the Aeneas `progress` tactic silently discharges any matching goal against the unverified specs. Headline theorems in `QuadraticExtField.lean`, `CubicExtField.lean`, and the `montgomery_roundtrip` chain look proven but bottom out in `sorry`. **The QuadraticExt / CubicExt inversion correctness contracts and Montgomery roundtrip / Fp arithmetic correctness chains are not actually established.**

### Problem 2 — `lake build` does not reject `sorry`s in the proof tree

`proofs/lakefile.lean` does not turn the `sorry` warning into an error for the project's `lean_lib`s (`Gf2Core`, `Gf2Algebra`). Consequence: the `lake-build` gate passes against any number of `sorry`s in hand-written proofs, so masked proof debt of the kind in Problem 1 cannot be caught by the gate alone.

### Problem 3 — stale narrative in `scripts/verify-lean.sh:14-26`

The script header still claims:

> "Charon panics in `src/pretty/fmt_with_ctx.rs:416` when extracting `gf2_core::gfp` ... The Step 1 extraction below will fail on a clean rebuild until this is resolved..."

This is no longer true: 9efd9c39 fixed the underlying Charon panic (asserts removed upstream) and added the `cfg(verify_lean)` gates in `gfp/mod.rs`. `verify-lean.sh` now runs end-to-end clean. The header comments are now misleading.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All 11 hand-written `Proofs/` sorrys enumerated above are eliminated. Specifically: the count from `grep -rn "^[[:space:]]*sorry$" proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/ proofs/Gf2Algebra/Proofs/` returns 0.
- [hard] No new `sorry` is introduced anywhere under `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/` or `proofs/Gf2Algebra/Proofs/` to discharge the proofs (no debt-shifting). Use `axiom` only when the lemma is a documented assumption (e.g., a Mathlib gap or a model assumption); each `axiom` must have a docstring identifying the gap.
- [hard] `proofs/lakefile.lean` + `scripts/lake-build-strict.sh` (or equivalent mechanism wired into the `lake-build` gate) cause `lake build` (as invoked by the gate) to exit non-zero on any `declaration uses 'sorry'` warning emanating from a path matching `^(Gf2Core|Gf2Algebra)/Proofs/`. Aeneas-generated paths (`*/Funs.lean`, `*/FunsExternal.lean`, `*/Types.lean`, `*/TypesExternal.lean`) are exempt; the carve-out must be documented in the wrapper script and lakefile.
- [hard] Verifiable via "negative test": with a single `sorry` planted in a fresh hand-written file under `Gf2Core/Proofs/` (e.g., `theorem _scratch : True := by sorry`), the gate exits non-zero. With it removed, the gate exits 0. The implementation must demonstrate this round-trip in the close-out commit message or session notes.
- [hard] After Problem 1 is fixed, `lake build` (via the strict wrapper) exits 0.
- [hard] `scripts/verify-lean.sh` lines 14-26 are rewritten to describe the current reality: Charon at upstream HEAD `1ec8d4bb` + 3 project-local patches, Aeneas at upstream HEAD `5fc8fdf2`, Lean v4.30.0-rc2, the `cfg(verify_lean)` gates in `gfp/mod.rs` that route SIMD overrides around extraction, and the `inline_default_methods()` post-processing pass. No claim that "Step 1 will fail" remains. Reference JIT issue 9efd9c39 for the upgrade context and this issue (`2e544a34`) for the residual proof debt.
- [hard] `./scripts/verify-lean.sh` exits 0 end-to-end with no `sorry` warnings in `Gf2Core/Proofs/` or `Gf2Algebra/Proofs/` files.
- [hard] `cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features --release --profile ci` exits 0.
- [hard] `code-review` gate passes.

## Approach hints (non-binding)

For Problem 1, group the work by mathematical structure:

- **Fp basic progress (`Progress.lean:379, 408, 412, 530`)**: `mul_progress`, `fp_new_progress`, `fp_value_progress`, `inv_progress` are routine WP compositions over `gfp::Fp` arithmetic. `mul_progress` likely chains `mont_mul_progress` (already proven) + a final `Fp.new` step. `fp_new_progress` and `fp_value_progress` are straightforward by `unfold; simp [spec, theta, wp_return]`. `inv_progress` may require a Bezout-style argument or Fermat's little theorem; check `ExtAlgebra.lean` for whether the pure-algebra inv lemma is already there.
- **Montgomery roundtrip (`MontgomeryRoundtrip.lean:591, 637, 644, 1345`)**: identify each site's theorem name, find its pure-algebra counterpart (likely in `ExtAlgebra.lean` or as a standalone Mathlib lemma), then thread the WP via `progress as` + `rw`. The `mont_add` / `mont_sub` REDC chain is the same shape as the `discr_v / discr_b` destructuring already proven in `Progress.lean`.
- **Extension inv (`ExtProgress.lean:105, 115, 219`)**: `qinv_closure_progress` should fall to `simp [closure_def]; ring` once the closure body is unfolded. `qinv_progress` is `qnorm_progress` + base-field `inv_progress` + the closure step. `cinv_progress` is the cubic version with one more cofactor.

For Problem 2, the wrapper approach is already wired (`scripts/lake-build-strict.sh` + `.jit/gates.json` gate command updated to invoke it). The wrapper greps for `^warning: (Gf2Core|Gf2Algebra)/Proofs/.*: declaration uses .sorry.` in `lake build` output and exits 1 on hit. A simpler in-tree mechanism (`weakLeanArgs := warningAsError=true`) was tried and rejected because Lean's `warningAsError` is global and over-fires on pre-existing project linter noise (deprecated `progress` tactic, unused vars, "tactic does nothing"). Cleaning that noise is its own refactor and out of scope here.

For Problem 3, `git log eca071bb..7421c283` covers the full upgrade context that the rewritten comment should reference.

## Non-goals

- The `[aspirational]` cleanup item from 9efd9c39 (remove the `cfg(not(verify_lean))` SIMD gates and the `inline_default_methods()` pass once upstream Aeneas fixes default-method extraction) remains tracked separately on 9efd9c39 itself; do not attempt it here.
- Aeneas-generated `Funs.lean` files in `Gf2Core` and `Gf2Algebra` carry pre-existing extraction sorrys (33 sites total: 26 in `Gf2Core/Funs.lean`, 7 in `Gf2Algebra/Funs.lean`). Those are extraction artefacts, not proof debt — out of scope here. The `silence_extraction_sorry()` post-processing pass and the strict-wrapper carve-out together exempt them from the gate.
- Cleanup of pre-existing project linter noise (deprecated Aeneas `progress` tactic syntax across `Proofs/`, unused-variable warnings, "tactic does nothing" reminders) is out of scope. The strict wrapper sidesteps these specifically by greping only for sorry warnings.

## Reference

Reviewer output: `jit gate check-all 9efd9c39 --json --full` → `results[gate_key=code-review].stdout` (run_id `e58a259e-3edd-4de8-8c9e-c9418ed144af`, `commit 4cd84f6c`).

Predecessor issue: 9efd9c39 (Done, milestone:1.0).
